title: Conveyance: A Versatile Framework for Learning in Structured Class Spaces
abstract: arXiv:2605.28420v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: While machine learning (ML) architectures have evolved rapidly to account for complex data, loss functions like cross-entropy remain mostly structure-agnostic in many real-world applications. However, the "class-symmetric" nature of these standard losses fundamentally limits the ability of ML models to exploit structural relationships between classes, particularly when facing structured noise. We propose Conveyance, a new classification approach and associated loss function tailored to structured class spaces. It allows users to encode graph-like relations between classes without having to define complex joint distributions or manually tune utility matrices. Technically, our loss function operates by maximizing two separate margins over distinct class partitions, while preserving formal properties such as monotonicity and partial convexity. translated_title: Conveyance：一种用于结构化类别空间学习的通用框架
translated_abstract: 尽管机器学习（ML）架构已经迅速发展以应对复杂数据，但在许多实际应用中，交叉熵等损失函数在很大程度上仍然对结构不敏感。然而，这些标准损失函数的“类别对称”特性从根本上限制了机器学习模型利用类别之间结构关系的能力，尤其是在面对结构化噪声时。我们提出了Conveyance，一种专为结构化类别空间设计的新分类方法及配套损失函数。它允许用户对类别之间的图状关系进行编码，而无需定义复杂的联合分布或手动调整效用矩阵。在技术上，我们的损失函数通过在不同的类别划分上最大化两个独立的间隔来运作，同时保持单调性和部分凸性等形式化性质。我们通过将其应用于层次（摘要在此处被截断）展示了我们方法的通用性和有效性。
tldr: 提出了Conveyance，一种专为结构化类别空间设计的分类损失函数，用户可直接编码类别间的图状关系而无需手动定义复杂分布或调整效用矩阵，通过在类别划分上最大化双间隔并保持单调性与部分凸性，克服了传统损失函数类别对称性的局限。
en_tdlr: We propose Conveyance, a classification loss function tailored to structured class spaces that allows users to encode graph-like relations between classes without complex joint distributions or utility matrix tuning, maximizing dual margins over class partitions while preserving monotonicity and partial convexity to overcome the class-symmetric limitations of standard losses.
